name: Awesome Digital Resources
description: 全球开发者与极客共同维护的开放数字资源目录 · 汇聚多领域开源工具与未分类小众实用宝藏
descriptionEn: Curated collection of digital gems, community tools, and uncategorized open source utilities.
warningText: 社区验证纯净；使用前请查阅各独立项目的官方说明与协议声明。
warningTextEn: Community verified clean; review license and documentation before use.

description: 免费开源的 Home Assistant 自定义集成，让三星洗衣机、冰箱、空调、洗碗机等家电走局域网直连，不用三星云账号，状态推送快、断网也能控，MIT 协议。
descriptionEn: Free open-source Home Assistant custom integration that controls Samsung washers, fridges, air conditioners, dishwashers and more over your local network, with no Samsung cloud account, fast push updates, and control that keeps working offline.
name: LocalThings
subcategory: Home Assistant 三星家电本地集成
warningText: 避坑提醒：只认约 2022 年后、能连 SmartThings 应用的三星家电，部分型号是只读、看不到全部功能；要先装好 Home Assistant 并通过 HACS 安装；家电本身仍会自己连三星服务器，这集成只保证它不替你多传数据。
warningTextEn: Only Samsung appliances from about 2022 onward that work with the SmartThings app are supported, and some models are read-only. You need Home Assistant with HACS first. The appliance itself still talks to Samsung's servers; the integration just sends nothing extra.

name: RuView
description: 开源的 WiFi 空间感知系统：不用摄像头、不用穿戴设备，只靠普通 WiFi 信号就能实时测房间里有没有人、人体姿态、呼吸与心率，还能接 Home Assistant、苹果 Home 与谷歌 Home，MIT 协议。
descriptionEn: Open-source WiFi spatial intelligence: turns ordinary WiFi signals into real-time presence detection, human pose estimation, breathing and heart-rate sensing — no cameras or wearables — with Home Assistant, Apple Home and Google Home integrations.
warningText: 避坑提醒：完整 CSI 感知要另买 ESP32-S3 硬件节点，只用普通 WiFi 或 Windows 只能拿到 RSSI 粗粒度信号，演示模式则是模拟数据；呼吸心率是感应估算值，不是医疗设备，精度随环境变化；部分高级功能要接 Cognitum Spaces 激活。
warningTextEn: Full CSI sensing needs separate ESP32-S3 hardware nodes; plain WiFi or Windows only gives coarse RSSI signals, and demo mode uses simulated data. Breathing and heart-rate readings are estimates, not medical measurements, and accuracy varies with the environment. Some advanced features require Cognitum Spaces activation.

name: sure
description: 社区接手已停运的 Maybe Finance 的自托管个人理财应用，记账、预算、净资产、投资一站式管理，Docker 一键部署，AGPL-3.0 开源免费。
descriptionEn: A self-hosted personal finance app kept alive by the community after Maybe Finance shut down. Budgeting, accounts, net worth and investments in one place, deployed with Docker. AGPL-3.0 and free.
warningText: 自建需 Docker、Postgres 与 Redis 一整套服务，对新手门槛不低；AI 功能需自备 OpenAI Key，费用另计；财务数据备份责任自负，丢了找不回来；官方另有付费托管版，别和自托管免费版搞混。
warningTextEn: Self-hosting needs a full Docker, Postgres and Redis stack, which is heavy for beginners. AI features need your own OpenAI key, billed separately. You are responsible for backing up your financial data. The vendor also sells a paid hosted plan, separate from the free self-hosted version.
